constraints: If codec matches the picture's current type, no conversion occurs and the picture is returned as-is, unless compression is also passed.
compression is only honored when the target codec supports a compression quality setting (e.g. JPEG, HDPhoto) via the WIC/ImageIO APIs.
Codecs not supported in 4D 64-bit versions (e.g. PICT) require running the conversion on a 4D 32-bit version.

overloadMerges.note: picture is documented as in/out (source picture in, converted picture out); corrected direction from 'in' to 'inout'. Added default for compression (best quality = 1 when omitted).

params.name: picture
params.description: Picture to be converted (in); converted picture (out)

params.name: codec
params.description: Picture Codec ID: a file extension (e.g. ".gif") or a Mime type (e.g. "image/jpeg")

params.name: compression
params.description: Compression quality between 0 (most mediocre quality, high compression) and 1 (best quality, low compression)

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Converts a picture to a new codec/type in place, optionally applying a compression quality when the target codec supports it.
